purpose: AC-2 byte-identity oracle: default Krea 2 img2img at strength 0.3, captured 2026-08-22 from a release build of aa8e590 (the commit immediately before WP-E3) running as a second warm server on port 7898 against the same model directory. There was no pinned img2img oracle before this file.
provenance_caveat: aa8e590 is the commit before WP-E3, NOT the pre-programme binary: it already carries WP-E12b (shift IS mu, beta/beta57 on the ModelSamplingFlux table). So this oracle pins "unchanged by WP-E3", not "unchanged by the whole programme". The controller accepted that gap for the default path because AC-3 pins SigmaSchedule.krea2(numSteps:mu:) element-for-element against the pre-change Krea2Sampling.timesteps, and the default recipe (euler over krea2 at the resolution-dependent mu) touches nothing else E12b changed.

request.prompt: a woman sitting on the edge of a bed in a bedroom, warm lamplight
request.source_image_note: Resolved RELATIVE TO THIS FIXTURES DIRECTORY, and committed alongside this file (~1.4 MB). It is the AC-1 oracle's own output. It used to be referenced at its original path under ~/Pictures/ComfyBox, which is a temporary symlink to an external volume — a merge gate that turns into a skip when a volume is unmounted is exactly the silent downgrade byte-identity exists to prevent. The capture fed a byte-identical copy of this file; the pinned sha256, which the test asserts before use, is what makes the copies interchangeable.

image_sha256_note: SHA-256 of the PNG's IHDR chunk data followed by every IDAT chunk's data. See krea2-turbo-seed44821-oracle.json for why the whole-file hash is not the comparison: the embedded EXIF/XMP JSON key order is process-dependent. Verified 2026-08-22: the aa8e590 render and the post-WP-E3 render of this request differ in 346 bytes, ALL inside file offsets 233..1474 (eXIf + iTXt), and are byte-identical from the first IDAT chunk to EOF.
